topic: Practical demonstration of steady streamlined flow pattern over object in a smoke tunnel.
syllabus_extract: Practical demonstration of steady streamlined flow pattern over object in a smoke tunnel.
specific_objectives: 6.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the properties of atmosphere, flow over bodies, boundary layer.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of steady streamlined flow pattern over object in smoke tunnel; Safety: Ensure smoke density is controlled; Supervision: Instructor monitors trainee observation.
intro_questions: What are the three primary properties of the atmosphere affecting flow?
Define the term 'boundary layer' in fluid dynamics.
List two factors that influence flow separation over a body.

development.content:
Properties of Atmosphere
Flow over Bodies
Boundary Layer Formation
Streamlined vs Turbulent Flow
Smoke Tunnel Mechanics

Setup of Smoke Tunnel
Introduction of Test Object
Generation of Smoke Stream
Observation of Flow Patterns
Identification of Separation Points

Analysis of Streamlines
Effect of Object Shape
Reynolds Number Implications
Recording Observations
Comparison with Theory

summary_questions: Explain how the boundary layer affects the transition from streamlined to turbulent flow.
Describe the visual characteristics of a steady streamlined flow pattern in the smoke tunnel.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report comparing the observed flow patterns in this session with the theoretical predictions covered in LP 02 regarding fluid dynamics.
